name: KYC/KYB
challenges: Regulation (AML/KYC) varies by jurisdiction and sector; reuse of KYC across institutions is often not permitted or is contractually restricted. Duplicate onboarding is costly for firms and burdensome for users. Storing or sharing KYC data raises privacy and security concerns.
opportunities: Reusable KYC via attestations or verifiable credentials can reduce duplication while preserving regulatory responsibility. Attestation-based flows allow relying parties to verify without holding raw documents. Interoperability with identity frameworks (eIDAS, national ID) is emerging.
